Analyze trends, identify bottlenecks, and make data-driven recommendations to improve operational efficiency. Drive adoption of digital tools and innovative solutions that enhance commercial execution speed and scalability. Support change management activities and ensure successful rollout of new processes, tools, and technologies. Success Measures Growth in SPS task assignment volume and sales engagement. Increased sales productivity and customer-facing selling time. Improved stakeholder satisfaction and SPS value perception. Reduction in manual activities through automation and process simplification. Improved operational efficiency, execution speed, and business responsiveness. Adoption of AI-enabled workflows and digital transformation initiatives. Strong understanding of Agilent Quote-to-Cash processes and commercial operations. Hands-on experience with Salesforce, SAP CRM, CPQ and Gratis related enterprise systems. Experience with Power BI, data analytics, dashboard creation, and business reporting. Knowledge of AI, Microsoft Copilot, workflow automation, and digital transformation initiatives. Experience leading cross-functional projects and process improvement programs. Leadership & Behavioral Competencies Excellent stakeholder management and partnership skills. Strong communication, influencing, and presentation capabilities. Ability to inspire, and motivate team members to consistently deliver strong business results. Collaborative leadership style with a customer-first mindset. Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making skills. Growth mindset with passion for innovation, continuous improvement, AI, and automation. Ability to balance strategic planning with operational execution in a fast-paced environment. Evaluate IBP Deviations: Collaborate with Demand Planners to discuss and understand the impact of last month's Integrated Business Planning (IBP) deviations on the current month's plan. Generate Analytical Insights: Theorize potential insights, design and execute experiments to validate model performance and improve forecasting accuracy. Communicate Analytical Gains: Articulate the benefits of productionizing statistical models to business functions that can leverage the results of analytical processes. Educate on New Approaches: Inform and educate the organization on innovative analytical approaches and methodologies. Identify Data Science Opportunities: Recognize problems that would benefit from Data Scientist expertise. Communicate findings and recommendations to stakeholders through clear and compelling visualizations and reports. Strategic Data Recommendations: Provide strategic recommendations on data collection, integration, and retention requirements, incorporating business needs and best practices. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate data-driven strategies into business planning processes. Drive Innovation and Improvement: Stay updated with the latest advancements in data science and machine learning to continuously enhance our forecasting capabilities. Qualifications Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, or a related field.
